title: Injunctions.
bodyText: In any civil proceeding brought pursuant to this chapter, the court may also enjoin any activity that violates this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§468M-13]  Injunctions.  In any civil proceeding brought pursuant to this chapter, the court may also enjoin any activity that violates this chapter. [L 1992, c 231, pt of §2, §§3, 6; am L 1995, c 174, §§1, 2; am L 1998, c 248, §§1, 2]
